tie_wildflower_posy.name: Tie Wildflower Posy
tie_wildflower_posy.description: Tie freshly gathered herbs into a simple, thoughtful gift.

familiarity_milestones.message: Your carved charms have a confident, practiced finish.

familiarity_milestones.message: Your practiced hands turn fine clay into tokens worth a museum's notice.

build_wooden_toolbox.name: Build Wooden Toolbox
